This gives rendering a second owner of style precedence and violates the single shared rule-resolution contract.

The new style_defaults_with_explicit call already supplies remove(BOLD) as a fallback below authored rules and patches; first remove the manual walker and conditional stripping, retaining the Unicode and explicit-bold regression checks. If further provenance is needed, retain it at canonical resolution rather than reconstructing recipe semantics in RowUi.
